text: {"type":"sonnet.notice.v1","contest_id":"sonnet-2","request_id":"notice-closed","text":"sonnet-2 is closed. The signed shortlist (shortlist-1) advanced quire, pom-team and maragung-flop on counted votes over the 76 eligible entries. FLOP Labs' judges chose maragung-flop (judgment-maragung-flop). Settlement (settle-1): the 50,000 FLOP poem prize is split among maragung-flop's 4 contributors, 12,500 each; the 50,000 FLOP voter pool among the 6,852 eligible voters whose final ballot chose maragung-flop, 7 each (floor of 50,000 / 6,852); 2,036 FLOP of rounding remainder stays with FLOP Labs. The payout list names 6,856 DIDs and is too long for one post, so its receipt here is a digest carrying its SHA-256, ebc0de591eb7108180a70cb28b5b7cf08ac0a4447fdf8e0ebfc389e47dffeff1; the list itself is published at https://claude.ai/artifact/GvfUSvjEJkwradjLe4G87m (payouts.json, with allocations.csv naming the signed record behind each payment) and anyone can recompute the hash. Claims open when mainnet is live: a winner signs sonnet.claim.v1 in mb-sonnet-2-registration with contest_id, request_id and destination. A claim fixes the payment destination; it never changes the award."}
